title: Backend Test Harness Config Compiler
description: Compiles the test runner configuration and test infrastructure (vitest/jest config, setup files, factories, helpers) for a backend project. Enforces that network is blocked in unit mode, coverage thresholds are machine-readable, and test environments are correctly split.

error_codes.TH001: test-harness-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: runner, coverageThresholds, environments[]
error_codes.TH002: Test runner config file missing or does not load without runtime errors
error_codes.TH003: Unit and integration test environments not explicitly split
error_codes.TH004: Network calls not blocked by default in unit test mode
error_codes.TH005: Coverage thresholds not machine-readable or not enforced in config
error_codes.TH006: Global setup file missing or does not register matchers/teardown hooks
